# UI Foundation

Standalone React component library. Neutral is the default theme; TIS is optional. There is no ds-tis dependency and no Figma library in this alpha.

## Runtime and distribution

- React 19
- shadcn source registry: 4.18.0
- Base UI behavior engine: 1.7.0
- Tailwind CSS 4

## Agent rules

- Read this manifest before selecting or generating components.
- Read the selected resolved component contracts before implementing behavior or states.
- Install registry source instead of recreating component markup from memory.
- Use Neutral unless the TIS identity is explicitly requested.
- Use Comfortable density unless the product explicitly requires Compact or Spacious controls.
- Use Base UI render composition; do not translate examples to Radix asChild.
- Use the theme and foundation token contracts; never hardcode brand colors in components.
- Prefer an installable block when it matches the requested application pattern, then adapt its owned source.
- Use the chart recipe bundle for Area, Bar, Line, Pie, Radar or Radial visualizations and keep its text summary or an equivalent data table.
- Preserve visible labels, focus behavior, keyboard paths and responsive states.
- Do not claim a Figma library or handoff exists for this alpha.

## Themes

- Neutral: default, light and dark
- TIS: optional via data-ui-theme="tis", light and dark

## Density

- Comfortable: default; control heights 32 / 40 / 48px for sm / md / lg
- Compact: opt-in for dense interfaces; 28 / 32 / 36px
- Spacious: opt-in for generous and touch-oriented interfaces; 40 / 48 / 56px
- Apply with data-ui-density="compact|comfortable|spacious" on the document root

## Customizer

- Human interface: https://tis-experience.github.io/ui-foundation/#customize
- Machine-readable contract: https://tis-experience.github.io/ui-foundation/tokens/customizer.json
- Identity presets: neutral, tis, custom
- Base colors: neutral, slate, stone, zinc
- Fonts: geist, humanist, serif, system
- Typeset presets: compact (14px / 1.6 leading / 58ch), default (16px / 1.75 leading / 65ch), reading (18px / 1.9 leading / 68ch)
- Radius: none, small, default, large, full
- Outputs: css, registry-theme, share-url

## Foundations (50 tokens)

- Typography: --font-sans, --font-heading, --font-mono, --text-xs, --text-xs--line-height, --text-sm, --text-sm--line-height, --text-base, --text-base--line-height, --text-lg, --text-lg--line-height, --text-xl, --text-xl--line-height, --text-2xl, --text-2xl--line-height, --text-3xl, --text-3xl--line-height, --text-4xl, --text-4xl--line-height, --font-weight-normal, --font-weight-medium, --font-weight-semibold, --font-weight-bold, --tracking-tight, --tracking-normal, --tracking-wide
- Spacing: --spacing
- Radius: --control-radius, --control-radius-sm, --radius-sm, --radius-md, --radius-lg, --radius-xl, --radius-2xl, --radius-3xl, --radius-4xl
- Borders: --border-width-default, --border-width-strong, --focus-ring-width, --focus-ring-offset
- Elevation: --shadow-xs, --shadow-sm, --shadow-md, --shadow-lg
- Motion: --duration-fast, --duration-normal, --duration-slow, --ease-standard, --ease-enter, --ease-exit

## Component contracts

- Resolved source: https://tis-experience.github.io/ui-foundation/contracts/components.json
- 66 components across 27 behavior profiles
- Each contract declares behavior ownership, keyboard strategy, responsive responsibility, required states and consumer responsibilities.

## Blocks (4)

- Dashboard Overview (dashboard-overview): A responsive product dashboard with metrics, an accessible trend chart and recent activity. Installable registry:block. Exports: DashboardActivity, DashboardMetric, DashboardOverview, DashboardOverviewProps.
- Login Page (login-page): A complete sign-in surface with native form semantics, password recovery and account access guidance. Installable registry:block. Exports: LoginPage, LoginPageProps.
- Settings Page (settings-page): A responsive workspace settings form for identity, localization and notification preferences. Installable registry:block. Exports: SettingsPage, SettingsPageProps.
- Team Members (team-members): A member management card with identity, role, status and explicit row actions. Installable registry:block. Exports: TeamMember, TeamMembers, TeamMembersProps.

## Chart recipe bundles (1)

- Chart Recipes (chart-recipes): Six token-aware and accessible Recharts recipes: Area, Bar, Line, Pie, Radar and Radial. Installable registry:block. Exports: AreaChartRecipe, BarChartRecipe, LineChartRecipe, PieChartRecipe, RadarChartRecipe, RadialChartRecipe.

## Canonical machine-readable source

Read https://tis-experience.github.io/ui-foundation/ai/manifest.json before generating an interface.
